headline: Cost of Living: Why Cyprus Faces a New Wave of Price Increases in the Coming Months
summary: Economist Tasos Giasemidis told KYPE that inflation in Cyprus has moved from an isolated phenomenon to an entrenched trend. New price increases are expected in the coming months.
why: Persistent inflation erodes household purchasing power and can prompt central banks and governments to adjust policy, affecting consumer and real-estate sectors.
